structured_output.summary: The change implements String.prototype.trim and a TrimString helper that follows the spec. It calls RequireObjectCoercible, then ToString, with `?` propagation, in that order. It trims leading and trailing characters by the spec's white-space set: TAB, VT, FF, SP, NBSP, ZWNBSP, the Zs code points (1680, 2000–200A, 202F, 205F, 3000) and the line terminators LF, CR, LS, PS. It correctly leaves out U+180E. The 4 remaining test262 failures come from other unimplemented built-ins (Array.prototype.toString and RegExp), not from this code. I did not run the build or tests myself; the build and clippy results are from the gate report. The diff touches only the one in-scope file.
